scope: Sunnyvale (W El Camino Real / Hollenbeck / Duane / Bernardo / E El Camino) and Santa Clara (Halford Ave / El Camino Real)
method: Candidates came from dated Yelp city 'lunch specials' captures and a Reddit thread, were deduped against the master and rejected lists by name+city and by street address, then each one was re-read on its own business page. Hours are quoted from at least two captures where the captures disagree; a price is printed only when a page printed one.
